changes.observation: Dense bushes, grass and rock mottling were replaced by sparse winter silhouettes, bounded polygon rock planes and quieter flat areas.
Many short mottled ripples became fewer longer lines; visible bridge shadow and pier reflections are simpler.
The exposed flat boundary makes an interior taper more apparent; the parent concealed this region with dense vegetation rather than showing an unequivocal edge exit.
Identity reduction and all ten exact text entries remain; practical information retained its positions, size and contrast.

maintained_advantages: Readable ten entries once in four local bank clearings
Adult screen/mat and mic/chair action relationships
Coherent bridge deck, railings and piers
residuals: River exit through the opposite image edge remains unclear and looks tapered inside the frame.
Some ground/water/clothing tones and a date-clearing halo remain.
Screen under-deck shelter and the stronger overhead viewpoint remain partial.
